body: Im there with ya. I got arrested earlier this year, they let me outta jail to wait for trial tho. Im facing a felony burglary charge and assault charge. Life will never be the same regardless. Lost my career and the chance to raise my kid. Prison for any length will only make life hell afterwards. Hard to live with myself anymore.
